verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows published benchmarks or measured latency or recall numbers for Chroma's database performance. The community mention of better indexes (SPANN/SPFresh) gives no measurements. The context-rot research is about LLM long-context degradation, not database latency or recall, so it does not count.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims
